inputs.place: Science City of Muñoz, Nueva Ecija

warnings: Historical season counts are not forecasts or probabilities of crop success.
This rules model has no validated yield, profit or predictive accuracy estimates.
Only the Muñoz results have been reviewed in detail; other places have data coverage tests.
Rankings use all historical seasons and the shortest cycle; changing the season view does not rerank crops.

meta.location_name: Science City of Muñoz, Nueva Ecija
meta.scored_lengths: EcoCrop cycle minimum and maximum, capped at the window
meta.schedule_rule: preparation + shortest growing time + picking + clearing must fit the window; scores are for the growing time, planted after preparation
meta.weather_grid: MERRA-2 cell, 0.5 x 0.625 degrees: the weather is the average over that cell, not a reading at the field
meta.ranked_on: shortest cycle; ties broken by the smaller water gap

sample.quality_flags: Laboratory methods and sampling depth not stated.

soil.texture_mapping: USDA texture name grouped into light/medium/heavy; clay loam and sandy clay loam are called medium and sit on the boundary
soil.bswm_note: bswm_soil_map_units.csv holds bounding boxes only, hundreds of km wide, so it cannot identify the soil series at a point. The official BSWM shapefile is needed before drainage can come from a map rather than from the farmer.

rice.cycle_source: Pinoy Rice Knowledge Bank (PhilRice), NSIC Rc222 (Tubigan 18): matures in 106 days direct seeded, 114 days transplanted. https://www.pinoyrice.com/rice-varieties/ . Chosen because Rc222 and Rc216 are reported as the most planted inbreds in Nueva Ecija (Glover et al. 2020, Technology in Society 60:101227); Rc216 is 104/112 days, so the choice between them moves little. Days are counted FROM SEEDING: for transplanted rice this includes the seedbed, so 114 overstates time in the field. Rc222 is on the site's irrigated list; the rainfed option NSIC Rc192 (Sahod Ulan 1) also matures in 106 days after seeding, so the short figure holds for a rainfed variety too. Replaces EcoCrop sheet 1574's 80-180 days.
rice.limits_source: FAO EcoCrop sheet 1574: absolute and optimal limits for temperature, soil pH and texture.

rice.source: FAO-56 T12 rice Kc 1.05/1.20/0.90-0.60; used 0.90 (upper end; FAO-56 gives no rule for picking within the range). T11 30/30/60/30 = 150 d, Dec/May, Tropics. Paddy seepage follows the field's soil texture: 4 mm/d heavy clay, 8 mm/d sandy, 6 mm/d on average (used for medium soils; that reading is ours), from FAO Irrigation Water Management Training Manual 3 ch.4 (NOT FAO-56; FAO-56 does not model paddy water balance). The 4.0 in percolation_mm_day only marks rice as a paddy crop; the model takes the figure for the soil. Manual 3's 200 mm saturation and 100 mm water layer are NOT included, so rice demand is understated. Kc NOT climate-adjusted (Eq. 62/65).

mungbean.source: FAO-56 T12 'Green Gram and Cowpeas' Kc 0.4 (legume group value; no crop-specific Kc_ini printed)/1.05/0.60-0.35; used 0.35 per T12 note 6 = harvested dry, the normal case for mungbean as a pulse. T11 20/30/30/20 = 110 d, March, Mediterranean - the ONLY variant, no tropical one. 'Green gram' = Vigna radiata is standard synonymy, not stated by FAO-56. Kc NOT climate-adjusted (Eq. 62/65).

eggplant.source: FAO-56 T12 'Egg Plant' Kc 0.6 (Solanaceae group value; no crop-specific Kc_ini printed)/1.05/0.90. T11 30/40/40/20 = 130 d, October, Arid Region. No tropical variant. Kc NOT climate-adjusted (Eq. 62/65).

tomato.source: FAO-56 T12 tomato Kc 0.6 (Solanaceae group value)/1.15/0.70-0.90; used 0.90 (upper end). T11 30/40/40/25 = 135 d, January, Arid Region. All five T11 tomato variants are Arid/California/Mediterranean; none tropical. Kc NOT climate-adjusted (Eq. 62/65).

squash.source: FAO-56 T12 'Pumpkin, Winter Squash' Kc 0.5 (cucumber-family group value; no crop-specific Kc_ini printed)/1.00/0.80. T11 20/30/30/20 = 100 d, Mar/Aug, Mediterranean; other variant 120 d, Europe. Kalabasa = Cucurbita maxima = winter squash is our reading. Texture: guide says 'well-drained sandy loam or clay loam'. Kc NOT climate-adjusted (Eq. 62/65).

sitaw.source: FAO-56 T12 'Green Gram and Cowpeas' Kc 0.4 (legume group value)/1.05/0.60-0.35; used 0.60 per T12 note 6 = harvested fresh, the case for sitaw pods. T11 20/30/30/20 = 110 d, March, Mediterranean, the only variant. Sitaw is a cowpea subspecies; using the cowpea row is our reading. Texture: the guide names no soil class ('fertile, friable and organic matter rich'), so texture is not scored. Kc NOT climate-adjusted (Eq. 62/65).

snapbean.source: FAO-56 T12 'Beans, green' Kc 0.5/1.05/0.90. T11 15/25/25/10 = 75 d, Aug/Sep, California, Egypt, Lebanon; other variant 90 d. Texture: guide says 'well-drained clay loam'. Kc NOT climate-adjusted (Eq. 62/65).

cabbage.source: FAO-56 T12 'Cabbage' Kc 0.7 (small-vegetables group value)/1.05/0.95. T11 40/60/50/15 = 165 d, Sept, California desert, the only variant. Texture: guide says 'sandy loam preferred'. The guide does not state a drainage requirement. Kc NOT climate-adjusted (Eq. 62/65).

lettuce.source: FAO-56 T12 'Lettuce' Kc 0.7 (small-vegetables group value)/1.00/0.95. T11 20/30/15/10 = 75 d, April, Mediterranean; longest variant 140 d. Texture: guide says 'loamy soil'. The guide does not state a drainage requirement. Kc NOT climate-adjusted (Eq. 62/65).

potato.source: FAO-56 T12 'Potato' Kc 0.5 (roots-and-tubers group value)/1.15/0.75. T11 25/30/30/30 = 115 d, Jan/Nov, semi-arid; longest variant 165 d, Idaho. Texture: guide says 'loose loam or sandy loam'. The guide's temperature is for best vegetative growth; the tuber stage differs. Kc NOT climate-adjusted (Eq. 62/65).

maize.source: FAO-56 T12 'Maize, Field (grain)' Kc 0.3 (cereals group value; no crop-specific Kc_ini printed)/1.20/0.60-0.35; used 0.60 (upper end = harvested at high grain moisture, T12 note 11). T11 20/35/40/30 = 125 d, June, Nigeria (humid), the shortest variant and a humid-tropics one; longest 180 d, East Africa. https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0b.htm Kc NOT climate-adjusted (Eq. 62/65).

sweetcorn.source: FAO-56 T12 'Maize, Sweet' Kc 0.3 (cereals group value)/1.15/1.05. T11 20/20/30/10 = 80 d, March, Philippines: the one Philippine stage row in Table 11; longest variant 140 d, California desert. https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0b.htm Kc NOT climate-adjusted (Eq. 62/65).

peanut.source: FAO-56 T12 'Groundnut (Peanut)' Kc 0.4 (legume group value)/1.15/0.60. T11 25/35/45/25 = 130 d, dry season, West Africa, the shortest variant; others 140 d. https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0b.htm Kc NOT climate-adjusted (Eq. 62/65).

soybean.source: FAO-56 T12 'Soybeans' Kc 0.4 (legume group value)/1.15/0.50. T11 15/15/40/15 = 85 d, December, Tropics, the shortest variant and the tropical one; longest 150 d, Japan. https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0b.htm Kc NOT climate-adjusted (Eq. 62/65).

sweetpotato.source: FAO-56 T12 'Sweet Potato' Kc 0.5 (roots-and-tubers group value)/1.15/0.65. T11 15/30/50/30 = 125 d, rainy season, Tropical regions, the shortest variant; other 150 d, Mediterranean. https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0b.htm Kc NOT climate-adjusted (Eq. 62/65).

cassava.source: FAO-56 T12 'Cassava - year 1' Kc 0.3/0.80/0.30. T11 20/40/90/60 = 210 d, rainy season, Tropical regions, the only first-year variant. https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0b.htm Kc NOT climate-adjusted (Eq. 62/65).

onion.source: FAO-56 T12 'Onions - dry' Kc 0.7 (small-vegetables group value)/1.05/0.75. T11 'Onion (dry)' 15/25/70/40 = 150 d, April, Mediterranean, the shorter variant; other 210 d, arid region and California. https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0b.htm Kc NOT climate-adjusted (Eq. 62/65).

sweetpepper.source: FAO-56 T12 'Sweet Peppers (bell)' Kc 0.6 (Solanaceae group value)/1.05/0.90. T11 prints 25/30, 35, 40, 20 = 125 d, April/June, Europe and Mediterranean; 30 is used for the first stage because it is the value that gives the printed total. Longest variant 210 d, arid region. https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0b.htm Kc NOT climate-adjusted (Eq. 62/65).

watermelon.source: FAO-56 T12 'Watermelon' Kc 0.4/1.00/0.75. T11 10/20/20/30 = 80 d, Near East (desert), the shorter variant; other 110 d, Italy. https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0b.htm Kc NOT climate-adjusted (Eq. 62/65).

melon.source: FAO-56 T12 'Sweet Melons' Kc 0.5 (cucumber-family group value)/1.05/0.75. T11 'Sweet melons' 25/35/40/20 = 120 d, May, Mediterranean, the shortest variant; longest 160 d, arid region. Cucumis melo also covers FAO-56's 'Cantaloupe' row (0.5/0.85/0.60); the sweet-melon row is used because it asks for more water, and that choice is ours. https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0b.htm Kc NOT climate-adjusted (Eq. 62/65).

carrot.source: FAO-56 T12 'Carrots' Kc 0.7 (small-vegetables group value)/1.05/0.95. T11 prints 20, 30, 50/30, 20 = 100 d, Oct/Jan, arid climate; 30 is used for the mid stage because it is the value that gives the printed total. Longest variant 200 d, California desert. https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0b.htm Kc NOT climate-adjusted (Eq. 62/65).

sesame.source: FAO-56 T12 'Sesame' Kc 0.35 (oil-crops group value)/1.10/0.25. T11 prints stages 20/30/40/20 and a total of 100 d (June, China, the only variant), but the four stages add to 110. The printed total is used as the growing time and the stage proportions are scaled to it, as the model does for every crop; which of the two FAO misprinted is not known. https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0b.htm Kc NOT climate-adjusted (Eq. 62/65).

sweetsorghum.source: FAO-56 T12 'Sorghum - sweet' Kc 0.3 (cereals group value)/1.20/1.05. T11 'Sorghum' prints stages 20/35/40/30 and a total of 130 d (May/June, USA, Pakistan, Mediterranean), but the four stages add to 125. The printed total is used as the growing time and the stage proportions are scaled to it, as the model does for every crop; which of the two FAO misprinted is not known. Other variant 140 d, arid region. Table 11 does not separate sweet from grain sorghum. https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0b.htm Kc NOT climate-adjusted (Eq. 62/65).

broccoli.source: FAO-56 T12 'Broccoli' Kc 0.7 (small-vegetables group value)/1.05/0.95. T11 35/45/40/15 = 135 d, September, California desert, the only variant. https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0b.htm Kc NOT climate-adjusted (Eq. 62/65).

cucumber.source: FAO-56 T12 'Cucumber - Fresh Market' Kc 0.6/1.00/0.75. T11 20/30/40/15 = 105 d, June/Aug, arid region, the shorter variant; other 130 d, arid region. https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0b.htm Kc NOT climate-adjusted (Eq. 62/65).

radish.source: FAO-56 T12 'Radish' Kc 0.7 (small-vegetables group value)/0.90/0.85. T11 5/10/15/5 = 35 d, Mar/Apr, Mediterranean and Europe, the shorter variant; other 40 d, arid region. https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0b.htm Kc NOT climate-adjusted (Eq. 62/65).

gardenpea.source: FAO-56 T12 'Peas - Fresh' Kc 0.5/1.15/1.10. T11 'Peas' 15/25/35/15 = 90 d, May, Europe, the shortest variant; longest 110 d, Idaho. https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0b.htm Kc NOT climate-adjusted (Eq. 62/65).

cauliflower.source: FAO-56 T12 'Cauliflower' Kc 0.7 (small-vegetables group value)/1.05/0.95. T11 35/50/40/15 = 140 d, September, California desert, the only variant. https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0b.htm Kc NOT climate-adjusted (Eq. 62/65).

cowpea.source: FAO-56 T12 'Green Gram and Cowpeas' Kc 0.4 (legume group value)/1.05/0.60-0.35; used 0.35 per T12 note 6 = harvested dry, the case for paayap grown as a pulse (sitaw, the fresh-pod subspecies, uses 0.60). T11 prints stages 20/30/30/20 and a total of 110 d (March, Mediterranean, the only variant), but the four stages add to 100. The printed total is used and the stage proportions are scaled to it, the same reading sitaw already uses. https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0b.htm Kc NOT climate-adjusted (Eq. 62/65).
